charts.title: K2-141 c: orbits around K2-141
charts.description: The orbits of K2-141's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-141 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Malavolta et al. 2018 (2018AJ....155..107M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MALAVOLTA_ET_AL__2018): P 7.7485 d
